question:
In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom/Phrase.

Pitch and toss
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Pitch and toss"** refers to **a game of chance**. (भाग्य का खेल)

 
 
• **Example: **Investing in the stock market can sometimes feel like a **pitch and toss,** where outcomes are uncertain.
 
 
 
• **"Pitch and toss"** is used to describe situations where outcomes are highly unpredictable and reliant on luck. (भाग्य पर निर्भरता)
 
 
• **Example: **Life is often a **pitch and toss**, and we must be prepared for anything that comes our way.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **To feel unlucky** (दुर्भाग्य महसूस करना): To experience a sense of misfortune.

 
 
• **Example:** After missing the bus, he felt very unlucky.
 
 
 
• **To reveal a secret** (राज़ खोलना): To disclose confidential information.
 
 
• **Example: **She accidentally revealed the secret about the surprise party.
 
 
 
• **A brief account of something** (संक्षिप्त विवरण): A short summary or description.
 
 
• **Example:** The professor gave a brief account of the history of the Roman Empire.
